cn.t: Lauren Yee's "Mother Russia" earns widespread acclaim as a hilarious yet piercing political satire about post-Soviet Russia. Critics praise its anarchic humor, devastating insights, and standout performances, particularly a memorable Filet-O-Fish scene.
